agendas.name: Prospecting
agendas.description: At battle end, for each battlefield edge (not your own), select one LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit wholly within 9" of that edge and not within 9" of another edge: it gains 2XP. If total 4+ XP gained, the force gains +20 raw minerals.

agendas.name: Yield Prophecy
agendas.description: Pre-game: declare a Yield points number. At battle end, compare to actual: exact match = WARLORD gains 3XP; within 1 = 2XP; within 2 = 1XP. If WARLORD gains 2+ XP, the force gains +20 galactic intel.

agendas.name: Exhaustive Pursuit
agendas.description: Each time you gain control of a previously uncontrolled objective, it becomes Searched. Select one LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit in range for 2XP (max 4XP per unit). If all objectives are Searched, choose a resource type; if total 6+ XP, gain +20 energy sources.

agendas.name: Debt to Be Paid
agendas.description: Each time a scarred LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit destroys an enemy unit, it gains 2XP (3XP if you have fought this opponent before). If total 4+ XP gained, the force gains +20 biomatter.
